summary: Silver Point Specialty Lending Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report a regular monthly dividend declaration. On August 20, 2026, the Board of Trustees declared a dividend of $0.24 per common share, payable on or before September 30, 2026, to holders of record as of August 31, 2026. This is a routine distribution announcement for a lending fund, not a special-situation event. No strategic transaction, tender offer, or other extraordinary corporate action is involved. The filing contains only standard dividend information and XBRL exhibits, with no deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics.
